task:
Design kit phase 1 follow-up: fix the blanket pill-button rule (visual review of branch `codex/run-41502111201-1`). Continue on that existing branch. apps/web only.

WHAT I SAW (local build, 1280x900, SwiftShader): the home page and the Plan landing look right (orange/navy/neon tokens, Saira headings, pill actions). On /explore with an anchor (Achenar) the **catalogue result rows are broken**: `apps/web/src/app.css` now applies `border-radius: var(--radius-pill)` plus the raised panel background to EVERY `button` under `#main-content`/`.overlay` (the `:where(#main-content, .overlay, .context-chip) :is(button, .primary-button, …)` rule), and paints `.inspect-link` as a filled orange primary. In the result list each row is a grid: the row's `.result-select` button (the whole card: name, id64, distance, star class) renders as a tall navy OVAL with a 999px radius, and the adjacent `.inspect-link` becomes a tall solid-orange oval the full height of the row. The same rule will hit other list/row buttons: `.suggestions > button` (autocomplete options), `.system-map-browser li button` (Inspect body list), watchlist/compare rows, `.result-paging` buttons, map label buttons (`.galaxy-label--system`, which must stay unstyled text labels), the camera toolbar and any `data-map-interactive` control.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Replace the blanket selector with an explicit opt-in: pills only for short action controls — `.primary-button`, `.secondary-button`, `.quiet-button`, `.apply`, `.add-build`, toolbar/camera buttons, the Sign-in button, filter chips, tabs, pop-out triggers, and the row action pair (`Pin`/`Compare`/`Watch`) — using a shared class (e.g. `.kit-pill`) or a tightly scoped selector list. Row-selection buttons (`.result-select`, `.suggestions > button`, `.system-map-browser li button`, watchlist/compare row buttons, nearby-systems list buttons, label buttons) must keep their existing rectangular/soft-radius layout with `--radius-sm` at most and no raised background override.
2. `.inspect-link` inside a result row becomes a compact secondary pill (neon outline, auto height, vertically centred), not a full-height filled block; keep the primary treatment only for standalone CTAs (home hero, Plan landing).
3. Add a Vitest contract in `design-kit.test.ts` that renders ExploreWorkspace with a fixture result list and asserts `.result-select` and `.suggestions > button` computed border-radius is not the pill value and that `.inspect-link` inside `.result-list` is not full-height/filled (check class or computed style), plus a negative test that the global rule no longer matches a bare `<button>` inside `#main-content`.
4. Re-check Inspect (`/inspect?system=…`) and the watchlist/compare panels for the same regression and fix them under the same opt-in rule.
5. `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. Update the existing CHANGES.md design-kit entry (do not add a new heading). Visual validation still required before promotion; not deployed.
